_comment: Targeting rules and CV source facts for /hunt. Everything the matcher scores against and everything a tailored CV may claim comes from here. Nothing outside this file is invented — see huntCv.js.

candidate.name: Prabin Parajuli
candidate.currentRole: Cloud Infrastructure / AWS / Cloud DX Engineer
candidate.workAuthorization: Currently work-authorised in Japan. Requires visa sponsorship for Australia, the USA, and other countries.

evidence: Runs day-to-day AWS operations at WITS Corp (Wistron): IAM and security, monitoring, deployment reliability.
Delivered file-server migration work using AWS FSx and Robocopy, including cutover planning and validation.
Built and operates pprabin.com.np end to end: React + Vite frontend, Vercel Serverless Functions, DynamoDB single-table design with a GSI for queue and due lookups.
Built DO101 (do101.online), a 28-tool browser-based utility platform where image, hashing and encoding work runs entirely client-side via the Canvas API.
Built a spaced-repetition flashcards system (SM-2 scheduler, 5,700+ cards) with a serverless API and DynamoDB persistence.
Built a voice transcriber PWA with chunked browser recording and Gemini transcription, backed by SQLite.
AWS Academy Graduate — Cloud Foundations, plus 50+ completed courses in cloud, networking, Linux, programming foundations and generative AI.
Works daily in a Japanese-language IT environment; comfortable across English and Japanese documentation.
